item.description:
Release v5.5.0

Changes since v5.4.0

  • check working tree state
  • docs: add Project RAG resource optimization plan
  • feat: add indexing pause/resume functionality to RAG plugin
  • feat: optimize RAG indexing scope and pause control
  • feat: refactor conversation list tools and clean up unused code
  • feat: schedule inactive project RAG indexing during idle time
  • feat: update project implementation
  • feat(agent-rules-plugin): register ListAgentRulesTool and CreateAgentRuleTool
  • feat(AgentRulesPlugin): add settings view for managing agent rules
  • feat(AgentRulesPlugin): show project rules in settings
  • feat(EditorSwiftPlugin): add about view with feature highlights
  • feat(idletime): add idle prediction api
  • fix: Fix Activity Heatmap localization for Chinese
  • fix(agent-temp-storage): remove duplicate RuntimeBridge and create missing LocalStore
  • fix(Messages): scope updates and deduplicate history loads
  • i18n(activity-heatmap): add missing Chinese translations for About view strings
  • i18n(projects): add localization entries for 17 missing strings
  • i18n(projects): add missing Chinese translations for settings view strings
  • perf(RAG): defer inactive project indexing
  • perf(UI): reduce startup and conversation list churn
